steps.title: Sign of the Cross
steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Versicle and response
steps.versicle: Heart of Jesus, burning with love of us:
steps.response: Inflame our hearts with love of Thee.

steps.title: Novena Intention
steps.prompt: Offer your Sacred Heart novena intention for day {{day}} of the nine days of preparation for the Solemnity.

sh_daily_prayer.text: O Sacred Heart of Jesus, burning furnace of charity: in these days of preparation before Thy Solemnity, make of my heart a throne for Thee. Burn away what is unworthy of Thee, enlighten what is dark in me, and set my will on fire with Thine own love, that I may honor Thy feast not in word but in life. Amen.

prayer_to_sacred_heart.text:
O most holy Heart of Jesus,
fountain of every blessing,
I adore you, I love you, and with a lively sorrow for my sins,
I offer you this poor heart of mine.
Make me humble, patient, pure, and wholly obedient to your will.
Grant, good Jesus, that I may live in you and for you.
Protect me in the midst of danger;
comfort me in my afflictions;
give me health of body,
assistance in my temporal needs,
your blessing on all that I do,
and the grace of a holy death.
Amen.

Sweet Heart of Jesus, be my love.
Sweet Heart of Jesus, be my salvation.
Sacred Heart of Jesus, I trust in you.
Sacred Heart of Jesus, I believe in your love for me.
Jesus, meek and humble of heart, make my heart like unto yours.
prayer_to_sacred_heart.latin:
O Cor Iesu sacratissimum,
fons omnis benedictionis,
te adoro, te amo, et viva peccatorum meorum paenitentia,
hoc meum cor tibi offero.
Fac me humilem, patientem, purum et tuae voluntati omnino obedientem.
Da, bone Iesu, ut in te vivam et pro te.
In periculis protege me;
in afflictionibus consolare me;
sanitatem corporis,
in temporalibus necessitatibus auxilium,
benedictionem tuam in omnibus quae ago,
et sanctae mortis gratiam concede.
Amen.

Dulce Cor Iesu, esto amor meus.
Dulce Cor Iesu, esto salus mea.
Sacrum Cor Iesu, in te confido.
Sacrum Cor Iesu, credo in amorem tuum erga me.
Iesu, mitis et humilis corde, fac cor meum secundum cor tuum.
prayer_to_sacred_heart.source: Traditional devotion, popularized by St. Margaret Mary Alacoque (17th century)

schedule_note.brief_offset_correction: The brief pinned 'easterOffset +61 (Friday after Corpus Christi week)': under the engine's semantics +61 is the Friday after Corpus Christi itself (Corpus Christi is Easter+60, a Thursday), not the nine-day preparation. Corrected to +59: the window is Easter+59..+67, and it completes ON the solemnity, Easter+68 — the Friday after Corpus Christi week, exactly 19 days after Pentecost (pinned by the pack test for 2026 and 2027) — with the divine_mercy_novena convention of the feast day itself not due.
schedule_note.note: The annual nine-day preparation for the Solemnity of the Sacred Heart: nine days ending at the vigil of the feast (the novena completes on the solemnity, which the pack leaves out of its due window). The daily exercise is uniform across the nine days, so the session is a single static session; the {{day}} token in the intercession prompt resolves from the window's day index.
